code.purpose: Source files and the Gamma Compose wordmark.

components.name: Primary Icon Button
components.description: Compact send or stop action inside the composer.
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display:grid; width:28px; height:28px; place-items:center; border:0; border-radius:6px; color:var(--color-panel); background:var(--color-accent); } .ds-icon-button:hover { filter:brightness(.95); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Composer Surface
components.description: One flat boundary groups the prompt and its local context.
components.html: Local ✓ · GLM 5.3
components.css: .ds-composer { padding:10px; border:1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius:8px; color:var(--color-ink); background:var(--color-panel); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color:var(--color-accent); } .ds-composer textarea { width:100%; min-height:56px; resize:none; border:0; color:inherit; background:transparent; } .ds-composer small { color:var(--color-muted); }

components.name: Active Tab
components.css: .ds-tab { padding:4px 10px; border:0; border-radius:5px; color:var(--color-accent); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 9%, var(--color-panel)); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; } .ds-tab:hover { filter:brightness(.98); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Model Control
components.description: A low-priority model label that becomes selectable when real options exist.
components.css: .ds-model { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; color:var(--color-muted); font-size:11px; } .ds-model select { border:0; border-radius:4px; padding:4px 6px; color:inherit; background:transparent; } .ds-model select:hover { color:var(--color-ink); background:var(--color-workspace); } .ds-model select:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Persistence State
components.description: Truthful browser-local save status with inline recovery.
components.css: .ds-persistence { border:0; border-radius:4px; padding:4px; color:#a33b14; background:transparent; font-size:11px; } .ds-persistence:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, #a33b14 8%, var(--color-panel)); } .ds-persistence:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); }

narrative.overview: A compact developer tool that uses flat surfaces, cool neutrals, and explicit state so the interface recedes behind the work.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue is reserved for an action, selection, or focus state.

rules.name: The Flat Boundary Rule
rules.body: Do not combine a structural border with a diffuse shadow.

dos: Do keep persistence and model state close to the composer.
Do preserve keyboard and narrow-panel usability.
donts: Don't expose provider infrastructure as user-facing status.
Don't add unavailable controls as placeholders.
